specification.gate: Both opponent-adjusted offense and defense-allowed residual must have the same sign. Strength is the weaker absolute residual.
specification.bands: Below .025: none; .025–.075: moderate; .075–.15: strong; >=.15: exceptional. Negative mirrors positive.
specification.volume: Pass share/.55 or rush share/.45, clipped to [.5,1.5].
specification.calibration: Nonnegative ridge on signed band indicators times volume; residual target is actual team points minus its pregame PF/PA projection. Symmetric favorable/adverse point magnitude.
specification.combined: Joint six-coefficient fit, rather than summing independently fitted pass and rush effects.
specification.cutoff: Earliest kickoff in target week. Earlier outcomes only enter calibration 48h after estimated six-hour game end.
specification.selection: Fixed before this run. No threshold/penalty/cap search or target-season parameter selection.
specification.limitations: Retrospective corrected inputs; archived closing lines have unverified original timestamps. Not official Scout/Plug forecasts. No new home-field bonus.
